messages:
Nia CS: Heads-up   Preparing Acero QBR Friday. We had a surprise embeddings spike Wed night; want a short cost/play and an enablement slot.
Omar FinOps: please paste 30d totals + when the spike happened. I'll run baseline vs surge sims.
Nia CS: 30d = gen 1.0M tokens, emb 3.2M tokens. Spike window 2025-11-12 22:30-23:45 UTC added ~2.4M embeddings. Estimated invoice ~ $2.8k/mo pre-spike.
Rae SE: that pattern often comes from a cron job or feedback loop. I can run (A) 3x burst sim, (B) burst + prefix-KV cache, (C) burst + fallback model routing.
billing-bot: billing-alert: Acero reached 72% of monthly-retainer at 2025-11-12T23:50:12Z
Nia CS: perfect   we'll surface that bot alert in the QBR as the trigger for recommended buffer. Renewal risk note: customer paused an experiment due to cost surprise.
Omar FinOps: quick sim (toy): 3x embeddings would push monthly to ~ $10k. Recommend proposing 3 bands for retainer: $6k / $9k / $12k with 7-day safety credits. I'll produce numbers for the deck by Wed.
Juno Docs: I'll make a one-page "post-QBR config" with batching knobs, prefix cache snippet, and a rollback checklist for quantized model switches (customer reported output variance).
Rae SE: I'll prepare a 10-min enablement demo (batching + cache + model fallback) and a 2-slide tech appendix showing expected latency/cost delta.
Nia CS: Proposed QBR action slide: 1) baseline vs surge chart 2) recommended retainer bands + ask 3) enablement + template 4) short follow-up plan for quantization issues. Assign: Omar - cost table, Rae - demo, Juno - template, Nia - QBR facilitation.
Omar FinOps: noted. I'll also include a short unit-econ note showing embeddings vs gen per-token delta so execs see the driver.
Nia CS: thanks team 44d let's keep the deck <6 slides and call out the explicit ask.
